title: coraza-lsp project config
description: Project-level configuration for the Coraza SecLang language server. Place this file as `.coraza.json` at the workspace root.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON schema. Used by editors for autocompletion.

entrypoint.description: Rule file that bootstraps the full rule set (e.g. 'crs-setup.conf'). When set, cross-file references (skipAfter, SecRuleRemoveById) become warnings/errors instead of informational hints.

includePaths.description: Search roots for resolving Include directives, in order. Relative paths are relative to this config file's directory.

global.description: Index every file matching filePatterns under the workspace, not just what is open. Enables workspace-wide duplicate-id detection and cross-file go-to-definition, at the cost of O(workspace) indexing on startup.

filePatterns.description: Globs (relative to the workspace root) that are SecLang content. Only files matching these patterns AND containing at least one SecLang directive in the first 20 lines are indexed.

ignore.description: Globs to exclude from indexing, in addition to .gitignore.

diagnostics.description: Per-diagnostic severity overrides. Keys are diagnostic codes; values are severity levels.

extraOperators.description: Additional operator names registered by plugins that should be treated as known, so they are not flagged as unknown operators. Names may be written with or without a leading '@'.

extraActions.description: Additional action names registered by plugins that should be treated as known, so they are not flagged as unknown actions.

extraTransformations.description: Additional transformation names registered by plugins that should be treated as known, so they are not flagged as unknown transformations.
